tldr: This note proves an explicit all-original-record bracket for minimax absolute error and full-parent 90-percent honest maximum interval length of a given rare binary causal sensitivity functional on the entire unanchored bounded H\"older class. The lower envelope is \(N^{-\alpha}[\log(\mathrm e+N)]^{-(1-\alpha)}\) in the mild phase and \(N^{-\alpha}[\log(\mathrm e+N)]^\alpha\) at criticality; the new observable upper envelope is respectively \(N^{-\alpha}[\log(\mathrm e+N)]^{-\alpha}\) and \(N^{-\alpha}[\log(\mathrm e+N)]^{1-\alpha}\). All envelopes saturate at one. The severe phase is matched at \(\min\{1,N^{-b}\}\). Scalar pilot-switched shell polynomials improve the elementary upper bounds, but the exact mild and critical logarithms and equality of risk and honest-length orders remain open.
